scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mz80/core run build && pnpm --filter @mz80/assembler run build && pnpm --filter @mz80/c-compiler run build && pnpm --filter @mz80/cli run build && pnpm --filter @mz80/lsp run build && pnpm --filter z80-assembler-language run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @mz80/core run typecheck && pnpm --filter @mz80/assembler run typecheck && pnpm --filter @mz80/c-compiler run typecheck && pnpm --filter @mz80/cli run typecheck && pnpm --filter @mz80/lsp run typecheck && pnpm --filter z80-assembler-language run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @mz80/core run test && pnpm --filter @mz80/assembler run test && pnpm --filter @mz80/c-compiler run test && pnpm --filter @mz80/cli run test && pnpm --filter @mz80/lsp run test
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:versions && pnpm run check:boundaries && pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:pack && pnpm run check:vsix
scripts.open:vscode-ext: pnpm -C editor/vscode-ext run build:full && node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'); const {resolve}=require('node:path'); const ext=resolve('editor/vscode-ext'); const input=process.argv[1]; const ws=input ? resolve(input) : resolve('.'); const args=['--new-window', '--extensionDevelopmentPath=' + ext, ws]; const r=spawnSync('code', args, {stdio:'inherit', shell:process.platform==='win32'}); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);"
scripts.open:vscode-ext:examples: pnpm -C editor/vscode-ext run build:full && node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'); const {resolve}=require('node:path'); const ext=resolve('editor/vscode-ext'); const ws=resolve('..', 'mega-z80-examples'); const args=['--new-window', '--extensionDevelopmentPath=' + ext, ws]; const r=spawnSync('code', args, {stdio:'inherit', shell:process.platform==='win32'}); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);"
